question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

We have always been told __retaliation__ is not the key to resolving problems.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Revenge**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Retaliation **means an **act of revenge** or reprisal. (प्रतिशोध या बदला लेने की क्रिया)

 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah decided on a subtle retaliation by playing a harmless prank on her mischievous colleague.*
